_meta.purpose: Machine-readable shape curriculum for the Helion matmul-FAMILY perf characterization (H100 sm90). Iterate THIS in the harness; the human mirror is the inline shape list in matmul-perf-characterization-task.md (same dir).
_meta.hardware: DETECT at runtime (do not assume H100): read device props for L2 + SM count + compute capability. sm90=H100 (L2~50MB, bf16/fp16 peak~989.5, fp8~1978.9 TFLOP/s dense); sm100=B200 (larger L2, bf16~2250/fp8~4500 TFLOP/s dense, verify per SKU).
_meta.flush_policy: L2-flush buffer = max(256MiB, 3-4 x device l2_cache_size); a fixed 256MB may NOT evict on B200.
_meta.arms_note: tc_max_autotune = torch.compile(op, mode=max-autotune-no-cudagraphs); op = torch.matmul/torch.bmm/torch._scaled_mm(fast_accum=True)/mamba-eager-ref per kernel. It subsumes raw-cuBLAS + eager. Ratios: G_vs_tc=tc/seed, xD_vs_default=default/seed.
_meta.seed_mechanism_note: Seed under test = general FORMULA on BOTH GPUs (H100 TritonH100MatmulHeuristic; B200 TritonB200FormulaMatmulHeuristic, PR#3007) - fires on all shapes/dtypes, NO coverage gap. On B200 the helion_default arm IS the incumbent being beaten: the matmul_b200.json table (PR#2428, in-bucket fp16/bf16 2-D matmul only) where it fires, ELSE the base ~[16,16,16] fallback (that's fine - record default_source=table|base). NOT a separate arm. default_source=table -> head-to-head on the incumbent's tuned turf; default_source=base -> table declined and the formula rescues the catastrophic default (coverage win).
_meta.dtype_policy: primaries only: bf16 for matmul/bmm/mamba, fp8_e4m3 for fp8_gemm (fp16/e5m2/TF32 are future adds)
_meta.methods_note: both interleaved; per-round ratios; RETAIN raw per-round us for every round+arm. M1 canonical; M2's tc arm carries torch.compile host overhead on tiny shapes.
_meta.failure_policy: each arm try/except + per-config compile timeout; record status in {ok,compile_fail,oom,timeout,acc_fail}; n/a us on failure; NEVER abort the sweep
